subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should test-file exclusion apply only to plugin `plugins.code_safety` scans, or also to installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans through the shared helper?
rationale: The patch changes a shared security-audit helper, so accepting it decides a broader scan boundary than the plugin-focused false-positive report requires.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Thread the option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving installed-skill coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper change only if maintainers intentionally accept excluding test-named installed-skill files and require proof for that broader behavior.

options.title: Pause for audit policy
options.body: Hold the PR while the canonical issue settles whether test-file exclusion, string masking, or another audit policy is the permanent fix.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread the option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving installed-skill coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest recent security-audit hardening provenance for the affected scan-boundary decision.
